fieldValues.title: Dangling-edge policy
fieldValues.content: Cross-boundary relations MUST NOT appear in the slice's relations collection. They MUST be recorded in `slice.externalRelationRefs[]` with `relationId`, `sourceInstanceId`, `targetInstanceId`, and `relationType`. A non-empty list is provenance data, not a validation error. The `relationType` value in `externalRelationRefs` entries is NOT subject to RFC-005 definition-lookup in the slice archive.
